_what: A1 candidate-by-candidate paper-merit adjudication of research/hypotheses/candidates.json (14 candidates).
_structural_finding: Every sourceId in candidates.json resolves ONLY to a hardcoded citation object inside research/hypotheses/build-candidates.mjs:14-28 (CITES). The file's own header says 'citation metadata hardcoded from verified records'. `verified: true` is a hand-set literal in that table, read by nothing in the pipeline (build-candidates.mjs:239-241 uses the key only for inclusion). No sourceId resolves to a retained full text, PDF or extracted passage. Every candidate's evidence grade is therefore at best RETRIEVED-METADATA plus an author transcription of a claim, never PRIMARY-in-tree.
_verdict: 0 of 14 candidates supports a substantively separate, not-covered, reachable paper-level question. All 14 sit inside the drafted endpoint PUB-REPURPOSING, whose document is generated from this very file (repurposing-hypotheses.md:545 cites research/hypotheses/candidates.json as its data appendix).
